description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Cid (IV) v2)] and [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Cid (IV) v2)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Lightning abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Lightning abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Cid (IV) v2)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Cid (IV) v2)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Lightning abilities, chases Lightning ability with [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)] to user/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to party with at least 0-3/4+ Machinist or IV members in the party

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
